assessment: Integer line-pitch walking can make three contextual p78/p79 reflection boxes touch all four active targets, but only at different target-specific shifts.
No single global line-pitch shift covers O4/B4/G5/O5 together.
The all-four carriers also sweep broad page-76 highlight controls, especially O3/O4/O5 and G3/G4/G5, so the operation is not active-specific.
The carrier texts are contextual El Salvador/IMF/Bitcoin prose and contain no strict unit/order instruction terms.

decision.nextMove: Do not promote line-pitch walking of 3D reflected boxes as a selector. Reopen only if a source/clue names a specific reflection id plus target-specific line offsets or a global line-shift rule.
